messages.content: 我想在聖荷西附近的Walmart買蘋果、米飯和12罐瓶裝水。請顯示產品資訊和庫存情況。

function.name: walmart_purchase
function.description: Retrieve information of items from Walmart including stock availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_list.description: Items to be purchased listed in an array.

pack_size.description: Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is not use it if not specified.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to buy apples, rice, and 12 cans of bottled water at a Walmart near San Jose. They want product info and stock status. We need to call the function with location "San Jose" and product list ["apples", "rice", "bottled water"]. For pack_size, we have 12 cans of bottled water. The user didn't specify pack size for apples or rice. So we can provide pack_size array with length equal to product_list. The user said "12罐瓶裝水" meaning 12 cans of bottled water. So pack_size should be [null, null, 12] or maybe [0,0,12] but the function expects number[]. We can set pack_size for apples and rice as 0 or null? The function signature says pack_size?: number[], default is not use it if not specified. But we need to match array length equal to product_list. So we can provide pack_size: [0, 0, 12]. That matches length 3. Or we can provide pack_size: [1, 1, 12] but apples and rice might not have pack size. The user didn't specify pack size for apples or rice. So we can set pack_size: [0, 0, 12] or maybe [null, null, 12] but type is number[]. So we can't use null. So we can use 0. So pack_size: [0, 0, 12].

We need to call the function.
